title: Agent Delivery Proof Audit
description: One-time bounded evidence review of one public URL or digital artifact against up to five acceptance criteria. Includes source-linked findings, PASS/FAIL/NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW, limitations, and a timestamped report. Manual fulfilment; 24-hour target after complete intake.
required_input: One public URL or bounded artifact, up to five acceptance criteria, and delivery email
availability_note: Manual service. Delivery target starts after complete, accessible intake. A listing is not proof of a sale or a guaranteed outcome.

title: Supplier Quote Comparison
description: One-time service for buyers with 2-5 supplier quotes. Normalizes price, scope, missing costs, MOQ, lead time and payment terms into a source-backed decision packet. Missing information remains marked unknown.
required_input: 2-5 PDF, CSV, JSON or Markdown supplier quotes plus purchase requirements or scope
availability_note: Review the product page for current terms and availability.
